instructions: Which banking intent does this customer query express?

labels.activate_my_card: Activating a newly received card before first use.
labels.age_limit: Minimum age to open or use an account, or opening one for a minor.
labels.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using the card with Apple Pay, Google Pay or another mobile wallet.
labels.atm_support: Which ATMs or cash machines can be used, and whether the card works in them.
labels.automatic_top_up: Setting up or changing automatic, recurring top-ups.
labels.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Money sent in by bank transfer has not appeared in the balance yet.
labels.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cheque or cash deposit has not appeared in the balance yet.
labels.beneficiary_not_allowed: A payment or transfer was blocked because the payee or beneficiary is not allowed.
labels.cancel_transfer: Cancelling or reversing a transfer that has already been sent.
labels.card_about_to_expire: The card expires soon and a replacement is needed.
labels.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted: which shops, merchants or sites take it.
labels.card_arrival: Chasing a card that was already ordered and has not arrived. Not: how long delivery takes in general (card_delivery_estimate).
labels.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes in general. Not: chasing a specific card that is late (card_arrival).
labels.card_linking: Linking or adding an existing external card to the account.
labels.card_not_working: A physical card does not work at all. Not: one declined payment (declined_card_payment), nor contactless alone (contactless_not_working).
labels.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a card payment.
labels.card_payment_not_recognised: An unrecognised card payment appears on the statement.
labels.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A card payment was converted at what looks like the wrong exchange rate.
labels.card_swallowed: An ATM retained or swallowed the card.
labels.cash_withdrawal_charge: A fee was charged for withdrawing cash.
labels.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: An unrecognised cash withdrawal appears on the statement.
labels.change_pin: Changing or resetting the card PIN. Not: the app passcode (passcode_forgotten).
labels.compromised_card: The card may have been cloned, skimmed or its details stolen.
labels.contactless_not_working: Contactless or tap payments specifically do not work.
labels.country_support: Whether the service is available in a given country or to its residents.
labels.declined_card_payment: A specific card payment was declined, and why.
labels.declined_cash_withdrawal: A specific cash withdrawal was declined, and why.
labels.declined_transfer: A specific transfer was declined, and why.
labels.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: An unrecognised direct debit appears on the account.
labels.disposable_card_limits: Limits that apply to disposable virtual cards.
labels.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, phone number or email.
labels.exchange_charge: A fee charged on a currency exchange.
labels.exchange_rate: Which exchange rate applies, or how the rate is set. Not: a rate that looks wrong on a payment (card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate).
labels.exchange_via_app: How to exchange or convert currency in the app.
labels.extra_charge_on_statement: An extra or unexpected charge on the statement, of unclear origin.
labels.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or did not go through.
labels.fiat_currency_support: Which traditional currencies can be held or exchanged.
labels.get_disposable_virtual_card: Obtaining a single-use disposable virtual card.
labels.get_physical_card: Whether a physical card is available at all, and how to obtain one. Not: placing the order itself (order_physical_card).
labels.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional or spare card alongside an existing one.
labels.getting_virtual_card: Obtaining a virtual card. Not: a single-use disposable one (get_disposable_virtual_card).
labels.lost_or_stolen_card: The card has been lost or stolen.
labels.lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone has been lost or stolen, and app access with it.
labels.order_physical_card: Placing an order for a physical card. Not: whether one is available at all (get_physical_card).
labels.passcode_forgotten: The app passcode or password was forgotten. Not: the card PIN (change_pin).
labels.pending_card_payment: A card payment is showing as pending.
labels.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is showing as pending.
labels.pending_top_up: A top-up is showing as pending.
labels.pending_transfer: A transfer is showing as pending.
labels.pin_blocked: The PIN is blocked, typically after wrong attempts.
labels.receiving_money: Receiving money from someone else, and how they can send it.
labels.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund already agreed or issued has not appeared. Not: asking for one in the first place (request_refund).
labels.request_refund: Asking for a refund or for money back.
labels.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted and the money returned.
labels.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which card types and currencies are supported.
labels.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: A fee charged when topping up by bank transfer.
labels.top_up_by_card_charge: A fee charged when topping up by card.
labels.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque.
labels.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or did not go through.
labels.top_up_limits: Limits on how much or how often the account can be topped up.
labels.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted and the money returned.
labels.topping_up_by_card: Topping up using a card. Not: the fee charged for it (top_up_by_card_charge).
labels.transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction was charged twice.
labels.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a transfer.
labels.transfer_into_account: Moving money into this account from another bank or account.
labels.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A transfer was sent but the recipient has not received it.
labels.transfer_timing: How long a transfer takes to arrive.
labels.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification was attempted and failed or cannot be completed.
labels.verify_my_identity: How to carry out identity verification. Not: it failing (unable_to_verify_identity), nor why it is required (why_verify_identity).
labels.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying where the money came from.
labels.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or the card used to make it.
labels.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card does not work.
labels.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is a Visa or a Mastercard, or asking for one specifically.
labels.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is required at all.
labels.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: An ATM dispensed the wrong amount of cash.
labels.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal was converted at what looks like the wrong exchange rate.
